2610.11695.title: Structured Sentiment Analysis Using Sequence Labeling as Dependency Graph Parsing
2610.11695.paper_summary: This study addresses the problem of structured sentiment analysis, whose goal is to obtain a fine-grained sentiment graph where the nodes represent spans of sentiment holders, targets, and expressions, while the arcs define the relationships among them. Our proposed approach casts the task as dependency graph parsing, but departs from traditional parsing methods by solving it through sequence labeling. To do so, we leverage recent advances in linearized graph encodings that allow each word in the input to be assigned a label, effectively capturing the structure of the dependency graph. We conducted experiments on seven datasets spanning five languages (English, Spanish, Norwegian, Basque, and Catalan), showing performance competitive with leading, more complex single-model approaches.
2610.11695.paper_summary_zh: 這項研究針對結構化情感分析的問題，目標是獲得一個細緻的情感圖，其中節點代表情感持有者、目標和表達的範圍，而弧則定義它們之間的關係。<lb/>我們提出的方法將這項任務視為依賴圖解析，但與傳統的解析方法不同，通過序列標記來解決它。<lb/>為此，我們利用最近在線性化圖編碼方面的進展，使輸入中的每個單詞都能被分配一個標籤，有效捕捉依賴圖的結構。<lb/>我們在涵蓋五種語言（英語、西班牙語、挪威語、巴斯克語和加泰羅尼亞語）的七個數據集上進行了實驗，顯示出與領先的、更複雜的單模型方法具有競爭力的性能。
